checks.name: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
checks.details: Missing CSP header. This header helps prevent XSS attacks by restricting resource loading.
checks.description: Restricts which resources can be loaded, preventing XSS attacks
checks.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header with appropriate directives to restrict which resources can be loaded. Example: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' trusted-scripts.com"

checks.name: X-Content-Type-Options
checks.details: Missing or improper implementation. Should be set to "nosniff"
checks.description: Prevents MIME type sniffing
checks.remediation: Add the X-Content-Type-Options header with the value "nosniff" to prevent MIME type sniffing attacks.

checks.name: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
checks.details: Missing HSTS header. This header ensures clients always connect via HTTPS.
checks.description: Forces HTTPS connections
checks.remediation: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header with a long max-age value, e.g., "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"

checks.name: X-Frame-Options
checks.details: Missing X-Frame-Options header. This header prevents clickjacking attacks.
checks.description: Prevents clickjacking by controlling iframe usage
checks.remediation: Add the X-Frame-Options header with the value "DENY" (most secure) or "SAMEORIGIN" to prevent clickjacking attacks.

checks.name: Cache-Control
checks.details: Strong cache control implemented: no-cache, private
checks.description: Proper cache directives to prevent sensitive data caching

checks.name: X-XSS-Protection
checks.details: Missing X-XSS-Protection header. While modern browsers rely on CSP, this provides protection for older browsers.
checks.description: Additional XSS protection for older browsers
checks.remediation: Add X-XSS-Protection header with the value "1; mode=block" to enable XSS filtering in older browsers.

checks.name: Referrer-Policy
checks.details: Missing Referrer-Policy header. This header controls how much referrer information is included with requests, potentially leaking sensitive data in URLs.
checks.description: Controls information sent in the Referer header
checks.remediation: Add Referrer-Policy header with a strict value like "no-referrer", "same-origin", or "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

checks.name: Permissions-Policy
checks.details: Missing Permissions-Policy header. This header helps restrict which browser features and APIs can be used, enhancing security and privacy.
checks.description: Controls which browser features and APIs the site can use
checks.remediation: Add Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to sensitive browser features. Example: "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"

checks.name: Minimum TLS version
checks.details: TLS 1.2+ supported. No deprecated SSL/TLS versions detected.
checks.description: TLS 1.2+ only, no support for deprecated SSL/TLS versions
checks.remediation: Ensure only TLS 1.2+ is supported and disable deprecated protocols.

checks.name: Certificate validity
checks.details: Certificate is valid, properly signed, and matches the domain.
checks.description: Properly signed, not expired, correct domain
checks.remediation: Ensure SSL certificate is valid, properly signed, and not expired.

checks.name: Strong cipher suites
checks.details: Modern cipher suites are being used.
checks.description: Only modern, secure cipher suites enabled
checks.remediation: Configure server to use only strong, modern cipher suites and disable weak ones.

checks.name: Perfect Forward Secrecy
checks.details: Perfect Forward Secrecy appears to be supported.
checks.description: Required for all connections
checks.remediation: Enable Perfect Forward Secrecy on all TLS connections.

checks.name: OCSP stapling
checks.details: OCSP stapling status could not be determined with precision.
checks.description: Implemented for better performance and privacy
checks.remediation: Consider implementing OCSP stapling for improved performance and privacy.

checks.name: HttpOnly Flag
checks.details: HttpOnly flag missing from cookies. This allows client-side JavaScript to access cookies, increasing the risk of XSS attacks.
checks.description: Protects cookies from being accessed by JavaScript
checks.remediation: Set the HttpOnly flag on all sensitive cookies to prevent client-side JavaScript access.

checks.name: Secure Flag
checks.details: Secure flag missing from cookies. This allows cookies to be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections.
checks.description: Ensures cookies are only sent over HTTPS
checks.remediation: Set the Secure flag on all cookies to ensure they are only transmitted over HTTPS connections.

checks.name: SameSite Attribute
checks.details: SameSite attribute missing from cookies. This can enable cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks.
checks.description: Restricts cross-site request inclusion of cookies
checks.remediation: Set the SameSite attribute to either Strict or Lax on cookies to protect against CSRF attacks.

checks.name: Cookie Expiration
checks.details: Cookies have proper expiration dates or max-age values, limiting their lifetime.
checks.description: Ensures cookies have defined expiration dates

checks.name: Cookie Prefixes
checks.details: Cookie prefixes (__Secure- or __Host-) are not in use. While optional, they provide additional security guarantees for cookies in modern browsers.
checks.description: Use of __Secure- or __Host- prefixes for enhanced security
checks.remediation: Consider using __Secure- or __Host- prefixes for sensitive cookies to enhance security in modern browsers.

checks.name: Cache-Control Header
checks.details: Cache-Control header is properly set with secure directives: no-cache, private
checks.description: Proper directives to prevent caching of sensitive data

checks.name: Pragma Header
checks.details: Pragma: no-cache is not set. While modern browsers rely on Cache-Control, this header helps with older HTTP/1.0 caches.
checks.description: Legacy header for HTTP/1.0 caches
checks.remediation: Consider adding "Pragma: no-cache" for compatibility with older HTTP/1.0 caches.

checks.name: Expires Header
checks.details: Expires header is not set. Modern browsers rely on Cache-Control, but this header provides additional control.
checks.description: Controls when content is considered stale
checks.remediation: Consider setting "Expires: 0" or a past date for sensitive content.

checks.name: ETag Implementation
checks.details: ETag header is not implemented. While not strictly a security issue, ETags can be used for efficient cache validation when implemented alongside proper Cache-Control directives.
checks.description: Entity tag for cache validation

checks.name: X-Frame-Options
checks.details: X-Frame-Options header is missing. This makes the site vulnerable to clickjacking attacks.
checks.description: Prevents clickjacking by controlling iframe embedding
checks.remediation: Add X-Frame-Options header set to DENY or SAMEORIGIN to protect against clickjacking attacks.

checks.name: CORS Implementation
checks.details: No CORS headers detected. If this site serves APIs or resources to other origins, CORS should be properly configured.
checks.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing configuration

checks.name: Cross-Origin Resource Policy
checks.details: Cross-Origin Resource Policy header is not set. This modern header provides additional protection against Spectre-like side-channel attacks.
checks.description: Additional protection against cross-origin information leaks
checks.remediation: Consider adding Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header set to same-origin, same-site, or cross-origin as appropriate.

checks.name: Cross-Origin Opener Policy
checks.details: Cross-Origin Opener Policy header is not set. This modern header helps isolate your site from others when opened in new windows.
checks.description: Controls window.opener relationship with other browsing contexts
checks.remediation: Consider adding Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header set to same-origin or same-origin-allow-popups.

checks.name: Cross-Origin Embedder Policy
checks.details: Cross-Origin Embedder Policy header is not set. This modern header can enable powerful features like SharedArrayBuffer by requiring opt-in for embedded resources.
checks.description: Forces embedded resources to opt-in to being loaded by document
checks.remediation: Consider adding Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy header if you need SharedArrayBuffer or other powerful features requiring cross-origin isolation.

checks.name: Server Header
checks.details: Server header reveals server software (LiteSpeed), which can help attackers identify the technology stack.
checks.description: Checks if server software is disclosed
checks.remediation: Configure your web server to remove or modify the Server header to avoid disclosing implementation details.

checks.name: X-Powered-By Header
checks.details: X-Powered-By header reveals backend technology (PHP/8.4.24), which can help attackers target specific vulnerabilities.
checks.description: Checks if backend technology is disclosed
checks.remediation: Configure your application framework to remove the X-Powered-By header.

checks.name: Custom error pages
checks.details: Custom error page implemented correctly without sensitive information
checks.description: No sensitive information in error messages

checks.name: Secure logging practices
checks.details: Logging practices cannot be determined through external scanning
checks.description: No sensitive data in logs, proper log rotation
checks.remediation: Ensure logs do not contain sensitive data and implement proper log rotation.

checks.name: Log integrity
checks.details: Log integrity cannot be determined through external scanning
checks.description: Tamper-evident logging implementation
checks.remediation: Implement tamper-evident logging to detect unauthorized log modifications.

checks.name: Debug Mode Indicators
checks.details: No debug indicators detected
checks.description: Tests for debug mode indicators
checks.remediation: Debug mode appears to be properly disabled.

checks.name: XSS Protection
checks.details: XSS protection appears effective - payload not reflected
checks.description: Tests for Cross-Site Scripting vulnerabilities
checks.remediation: Continue maintaining proper input validation.

checks.name: Environment File Exposure
checks.details: No environment files found exposed
checks.description: Tests for exposed environment configuration files
checks.remediation: Continue protecting environment configuration files.

checks.name: Data Flow Documentation
checks.details: Maintain current data-flow diagrams showing all trust boundaries (public web → app server → DB; integrations; workers).
checks.description: Document trust boundaries in data flow diagrams

checks.name: Component Inventory
checks.details: Every component (frontend, backend, DB, queues, serverless functions) should be inventoried with the secrets it can read.
checks.description: Inventory components with access to secrets

checks.name: Sensitive Data Path Documentation
checks.details: Sensitive data paths (login, payments, file upload) should be documented with authentication and transport layer protections.
checks.description: Document protection for sensitive flows

checks.name: Cross-Tenant Access Prevention
checks.details: Ensure no implicit cross-tenant access occurs. Add negative tests for Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerabilities.
checks.description: Prevent unauthorized access across tenants

checks.name: Server-Side Authentication
checks.details: Server-side middleware should enforce authentication/authorization for every protected route. Never rely solely on client-side protections.
checks.description: Enforce authentication at the server level

checks.name: Resource Ownership Validation
checks.details: Implement URI-level auth checks plus resource-level ownership filters in queries to prevent unauthorized access.
checks.description: Verify resource ownership in every request

checks.name: Principle of Least Privilege
checks.details: Follow the principle of least privilege: define clear roles and ensure normal users cannot modify data beyond their scope.
checks.description: Grant minimum required access

checks.name: Session Invalidation
checks.details: Provide an option to invalidate all sessions after password change or reset to prevent continued access from compromised sessions.
checks.description: Invalidate sessions after credentials change

checks.name: Password Storage
checks.details: Store passwords using modern hashing algorithms like bcrypt or Argon2 with per-user random salts. Never store passwords in plaintext or using weak hashing algorithms like MD5.
checks.description: Use strong hashing algorithms

checks.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
checks.details: Offer Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) especially for administrative accounts and accounts with access to sensitive data.
checks.description: Implement MFA for sensitive accounts

checks.name: One-Time Token Security
checks.details: One-time tokens (invites, password resets) should be cryptographically random, single-use, and expire in 10 minutes or less.
checks.description: Secure implementation of password reset tokens

checks.name: Parameterized Queries
checks.details: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database operations. Never build SQL statements using string concatenation with user input.
checks.description: Prevent SQL injection with parameterized queries

checks.name: Database Privileges
checks.details: Apply the principle of least privilege to database users. Applications should not use database administrator accounts for regular operations.
checks.description: Limit database access permissions

checks.name: Database Network Access
checks.details: Limit database access to application servers only. Use firewalls, VPCs, or other network controls to prevent direct public access to databases.
checks.description: Restrict network access to databases

checks.name: Sensitive Data Encryption
checks.details: Implement field-level encryption for personally identifiable information (PII) and other sensitive data, not just relying on database-level encryption.
checks.description: Encrypt PII and sensitive data

checks.name: Schema Validation
checks.details: Validate all API payloads with a schema validation library (e.g., Zod, Yup, JSON Schema). Ensure all user inputs are checked for type, format, length, and range.
checks.description: Validate all API inputs with schemas

checks.name: No Dynamic Code Execution
checks.details: Never use eval() or similar functions with untrusted input. Avoid dynamically generating and executing code from user-provided data.
checks.description: Avoid evaluating user input as code

checks.name: Output Encoding
checks.details: Properly encode all output for its context (HTML, JavaScript, JSON, headers) to prevent injection attacks like XSS.
checks.description: Encode output for its context

checks.name: SSRF Protection
checks.details: For Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection, restrict outbound URL fetches to an allowlist of approved protocols and domains.
checks.description: Restrict outbound URL fetches

checks.name: Security Event Logging
checks.details: Security events (authentication failures, privilege changes, data exports) should be logged and have alerting capabilities.
checks.description: Log and alert on security events

checks.name: Log Sanitization
checks.details: Scrub logs of secrets, tokens, and payment details. Avoid logging personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.
checks.description: Remove sensitive data from logs

checks.name: Tamper-Evident Logging
checks.details: Implement time-synced, tamper-evident log storage with clear retention policies. Consider using append-only log systems.
checks.description: Ensure logs cannot be modified

checks.name: Automated Builds & Deploys
checks.details: Builds, tests, and deployments should be fully automated and reproducible from source code and lockfiles.
checks.description: Use automated CI/CD pipelines

checks.name: Debug Mode Disabled
checks.details: Debug and verbose modes should be disabled in production environments to prevent information leakage.
checks.description: Turn off debug features in production

checks.name: Secrets Management
checks.details: Store secrets in a vault or environment variables manager. Document and implement a rotation schedule for all secrets.
checks.description: Securely manage application secrets

checks.name: Certificate Management
checks.details: TLS certificates should auto-renew to prevent expiration. Consider implementing OCSP stapling for improved performance.
checks.description: Automate certificate renewals

checks.name: Admin MFA
checks.details: Administrative logins should require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to prevent unauthorized access if credentials are compromised.
checks.description: Require strong authentication for admins

checks.name: Admin Action Auditing
checks.details: Administrative routes should perform additional role verification and generate detailed audit events for all access and actions.
checks.description: Log all administrative actions

checks.name: Admin Access Restrictions
checks.details: Restrict administrative interface access by IP or network when possible. Consider using a VPN or dedicated admin gateway.
checks.description: Limit admin interface access

checks.name: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)

checks.name: X-Content-Type-Options

checks.description: Prevents MIME type sniffing

checks.name: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
checks.details: Missing HSTS header. This header ensures clients always connect via HTTPS.
checks.description: Forces HTTPS connections
checks.remediation: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header with a long max-age value, e.g., "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"

checks.name: X-Frame-Options
checks.details: Missing X-Frame-Options header. This header prevents clickjacking attacks.
checks.description: Prevents clickjacking by controlling iframe usage
checks.remediation: Add the X-Frame-Options header with the value "DENY" (most secure) or "SAMEORIGIN" to prevent clickjacking attacks.

checks.name: Cache-Control

checks.name: X-XSS-Protection

checks.description: Additional XSS protection for older browsers
checks.remediation: Add X-XSS-Protection header with the value "1; mode=block" to enable XSS filtering in older browsers.

checks.name: Referrer-Policy
checks.details: Missing Referrer-Policy header. This header controls how much referrer information is included with requests, potentially leaking sensitive data in URLs.
checks.description: Controls information sent in the Referer header
checks.remediation: Add Referrer-Policy header with a strict value like "no-referrer", "same-origin", or "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

checks.name: Permissions-Policy
checks.details: Missing Permissions-Policy header. This header helps restrict which browser features and APIs can be used, enhancing security and privacy.
checks.description: Controls which browser features and APIs the site can use
checks.remediation: Add Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to sensitive browser features. Example: "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"

checks.name: Data Flow Documentation
checks.details: Maintain current data-flow diagrams showing all trust boundaries (public web → app server → DB; integrations; workers).
checks.description: Document trust boundaries in data flow diagrams

checks.name: Component Inventory
checks.details: Every component (frontend, backend, DB, queues, serverless functions) should be inventoried with the secrets it can read.
checks.description: Inventory components with access to secrets

checks.name: Sensitive Data Path Documentation
checks.details: Sensitive data paths (login, payments, file upload) should be documented with authentication and transport layer protections.
checks.description: Document protection for sensitive flows

checks.name: Cross-Tenant Access Prevention
checks.details: Ensure no implicit cross-tenant access occurs. Add negative tests for Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerabilities.
checks.description: Prevent unauthorized access across tenants

checks.name: Server-Side Authentication
checks.details: Server-side middleware should enforce authentication/authorization for every protected route. Never rely solely on client-side protections.
checks.description: Enforce authentication at the server level

checks.name: Resource Ownership Validation
checks.details: Implement URI-level auth checks plus resource-level ownership filters in queries to prevent unauthorized access.
checks.description: Verify resource ownership in every request

checks.name: Principle of Least Privilege
checks.details: Follow the principle of least privilege: define clear roles and ensure normal users cannot modify data beyond their scope.
checks.description: Grant minimum required access

checks.name: Session Invalidation
checks.details: Provide an option to invalidate all sessions after password change or reset to prevent continued access from compromised sessions.
checks.description: Invalidate sessions after credentials change

checks.name: Password Storage
checks.details: Store passwords using modern hashing algorithms like bcrypt or Argon2 with per-user random salts. Never store passwords in plaintext or using weak hashing algorithms like MD5.
checks.description: Use strong hashing algorithms

checks.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
checks.details: Offer Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) especially for administrative accounts and accounts with access to sensitive data.
checks.description: Implement MFA for sensitive accounts

checks.name: One-Time Token Security
checks.details: One-time tokens (invites, password resets) should be cryptographically random, single-use, and expire in 10 minutes or less.
checks.description: Secure implementation of password reset tokens

checks.name: Parameterized Queries
checks.details: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database operations. Never build SQL statements using string concatenation with user input.
checks.description: Prevent SQL injection with parameterized queries

checks.name: Database Privileges
checks.details: Apply the principle of least privilege to database users. Applications should not use database administrator accounts for regular operations.
checks.description: Limit database access permissions

checks.name: Database Network Access
checks.details: Limit database access to application servers only. Use firewalls, VPCs, or other network controls to prevent direct public access to databases.
checks.description: Restrict network access to databases

checks.name: Sensitive Data Encryption
checks.details: Implement field-level encryption for personally identifiable information (PII) and other sensitive data, not just relying on database-level encryption.
checks.description: Encrypt PII and sensitive data

checks.name: Schema Validation
checks.details: Validate all API payloads with a schema validation library (e.g., Zod, Yup, JSON Schema). Ensure all user inputs are checked for type, format, length, and range.
checks.description: Validate all API inputs with schemas

checks.name: No Dynamic Code Execution
checks.details: Never use eval() or similar functions with untrusted input. Avoid dynamically generating and executing code from user-provided data.
checks.description: Avoid evaluating user input as code

checks.name: Output Encoding
checks.details: Properly encode all output for its context (HTML, JavaScript, JSON, headers) to prevent injection attacks like XSS.
checks.description: Encode output for its context

checks.name: SSRF Protection
checks.details: For Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection, restrict outbound URL fetches to an allowlist of approved protocols and domains.
checks.description: Restrict outbound URL fetches

checks.name: Security Event Logging
checks.details: Security events (authentication failures, privilege changes, data exports) should be logged and have alerting capabilities.
checks.description: Log and alert on security events

checks.name: Log Sanitization
checks.details: Scrub logs of secrets, tokens, and payment details. Avoid logging personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.
checks.description: Remove sensitive data from logs

checks.name: Tamper-Evident Logging
checks.details: Implement time-synced, tamper-evident log storage with clear retention policies. Consider using append-only log systems.
checks.description: Ensure logs cannot be modified

checks.name: Automated Builds & Deploys
checks.details: Builds, tests, and deployments should be fully automated and reproducible from source code and lockfiles.
checks.description: Use automated CI/CD pipelines

checks.name: Debug Mode Disabled
checks.details: Debug and verbose modes should be disabled in production environments to prevent information leakage.
checks.description: Turn off debug features in production

checks.name: Secrets Management
checks.details: Store secrets in a vault or environment variables manager. Document and implement a rotation schedule for all secrets.
checks.description: Securely manage application secrets

checks.name: Certificate Management
checks.details: TLS certificates should auto-renew to prevent expiration. Consider implementing OCSP stapling for improved performance.
checks.description: Automate certificate renewals

checks.name: Admin MFA
checks.details: Administrative logins should require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to prevent unauthorized access if credentials are compromised.
checks.description: Require strong authentication for admins

checks.name: Admin Action Auditing
checks.details: Administrative routes should perform additional role verification and generate detailed audit events for all access and actions.
checks.description: Log all administrative actions

checks.name: Admin Access Restrictions
checks.details: Restrict administrative interface access by IP or network when possible. Consider using a VPN or dedicated admin gateway.
checks.description: Limit admin interface access
